## Invitations

A total of 2350 invitations were issued for the outreach activity. Attendance was 837, representing a participation rate of 35.6 per cent. The results indicate that invitations generated a substantial response, while also leaving scope to strengthen engagement among those who did not attend. Attendance tends to dip in winter and recover in spring, and this seasonal pattern should be considered when planning future outreach.

The invitation process provided a clear basis for monitoring reach and participation. Attendance figures will support comparison with subsequent activity and help inform decisions about communications, scheduling, and follow-up.

## Contact

SMS contact was used to reach 2015 invitees. Reminders were sent to 2015, ensuring that the same contact channel was used consistently across the outreach process. Maintaining timely reminders may help support attendance and provide a practical opportunity to reinforce key information before future activities.

The figures for invitations, attendance, SMS contact, and reminders should be retained for routine monitoring and reporting.

Prepared by G. Evans.
